Let \(t=\lg(\lg 2)\). Since \(\log_2 10=\frac1{\lg 2}\), we have

\[
\lg(\log_2 10)=\lg\left(\frac1{\lg 2}\right)=-\lg(\lg 2)=-t.
\]

The function \(g(x)=ax^3+b\sin x\) is odd. Given

\[
f(-t)=5 \implies g(-t)+4=5 \implies -g(t)=1 \implies g(t)=-1.
\]

Therefore,

\[
f(t)=g(t)+4=-1+4=3.
\]

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
